clips.title: The story
paras: Gelriz has been muscling out the moguls appointed by the trade princes and now makes a move on the most notorious pirate of all, and Baron Revilgaz will not stand for it. In response, Kebok in Booty Bay directs adventurers to steal strange blue crystals that Venture Company geologists have been finding near Lake Nazferiti.

Gelriz has stepped over the line by shoving aside moguls chosen by the trade princes and making a move on the most notorious pirate of all. Baron Revilgaz refuses to permit such insolence, instructing Kebok to handle the intrusion however he sees fit. Kebok's chosen response is outright theft, targeting the strange blue stones that Venture Company mining crews have been unearthing.

Venture Company geologists operating around Lake Nazferiti have taken a keen interest in these unusual crystals. Kebok wants eight samples brought back to Booty Bay, unconcerned with how they are acquired so long as they end up in his hands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: He's done it this time! Bad enough that Gelriz's muscling out the moguls who were appointed by the trade princes, now he tries to cut in on the most notorious pirate!
Revilgaz won't have it, and he's told me to take care of the problem in my own way.

My way? Theft. The Venture Co. Geologists near Lake Nazferiti are deeply interested in those strange blue crystals they have been finding in the mines. Bring me samples of the stone from their geologists, I don't care what you have to do to get them.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I need those stones, friend. By whatever means necessary! Just do it, don't give me the details!
It's about results, friend, nothing more, nothing less.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Fascinating. That the crystals have been tumbled using this process can only indicate that they are planning to use them as some sort of fuel or other catalyst. I don't know much more than that. Samples will have to be dispatched to Head Chemist Gigglefont.
